events.title: Google ships Gemini 3.7 Flash, its workhorse model for coding and agents
events.title_zh: Google 发布 Gemini 3.7 Flash，首发价 5 折
events.summary: Google shipped Gemini 3.7 Flash three weeks after 3.6 Flash, positioning it as its most capable workhorse model for coding and agents. It went GA on day one in the Gemini API and AI Studio, and landed in GitHub Copilot the same day. Intro pricing is $0.75/M input and $3.75/M output through 2026-12-31, then reverts to $1.50/$7.50.
events.why_it_matters: Near-frontier agentic scores at under $1/M input change the default model choice for high-volume agent loops. The three-week Flash cadence is itself a competitive-velocity signal.
events.summary_zh: Google 在 3.6 Flash 发布三周后推出 Gemini 3.7 Flash，定位是面向 coding 和 agent 的主力模型。Gemini API 和 AI Studio 首日 GA，GitHub Copilot 同日可用。首发优惠价 input $0.75/M、output $3.75/M，2026-12-31 截止，之后恢复 $1.50/$7.50。
events.summary_en: Google shipped Gemini 3.7 Flash three weeks after 3.6 Flash, positioning it as its most capable workhorse model for coding and agents. It went GA on day one in the Gemini API and AI Studio, and landed in GitHub Copilot the same day. Intro pricing is $0.75/M input and $3.75/M output through 2026-12-31, then reverts to $1.50/$7.50.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对跑高频 agent 循环的团队来说，接近前沿水平的 agent 成绩配上低于 $1/M 的 input 价，会直接改变默认选型。三周一更的 Flash 节奏本身也是竞争速度的信号。
events.why_it_matters_en: Near-frontier agentic scores at under $1/M input change the default model choice for high-volume agent loops. The three-week Flash cadence is itself a competitive-velocity signal.

events.title: DeepSeek V4-Pro goes GA with native OpenAI Responses API support
events.title_zh: DeepSeek V4-Pro 正式 GA，原生支持 Responses API
events.summary: DeepSeek moved V4-Pro from preview to GA across app, web, and API (deepseek-v4-pro), with native OpenAI Responses API support and a one-click Codex configuration. Thinking-effort levels (low/high/max) were added for V4-Pro and V4-Flash. Peak/off-peak pricing takes effect 2026-08-16T16:00Z, with off-peak at 50% of peak.
events.why_it_matters: Responses-API compatibility makes DeepSeek a near drop-in inside OpenAI-native agent stacks. The confirmed peak/off-peak rates are a large increase over the current flat rates: V4-Pro output rises from $0.87 to $3.96/Mtok at peak and $1.98 off-peak, effective 2026-08-16T16:00Z. Budget-sensitive agent workloads now need time-of-day scheduling or a fresh cost review.
events.summary_zh: DeepSeek 将 V4-Pro 从预览转为 GA，覆盖 app、web 和 API（模型名 deepseek-v4-pro）。它原生支持 OpenAI Responses API，并提供一键 Codex 配置。V4-Pro 和 V4-Flash 新增思考强度（thinking-effort）三档：low、high、max。峰谷定价于 2026-08-16T16:00Z 生效，闲时价为峰时的 50%。
events.summary_en: DeepSeek moved V4-Pro from preview to GA across app, web, and API (deepseek-v4-pro), with native OpenAI Responses API support and a one-click Codex configuration. Thinking-effort levels (low/high/max) were added for V4-Pro and V4-Flash. Peak/off-peak pricing takes effect 2026-08-16T16:00Z, with off-peak at 50% of peak.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对用 OpenAI 原生技术栈搭 agent 的团队，DeepSeek 现在接近即插即用，迁移成本很低。但这不是降价而是涨价：2026-08-16T16:00Z 起峰谷定价生效，V4-Pro output 从 $0.87 涨到峰时 $3.96/Mtok、闲时 $1.98。预算敏感的 agent 负载要按时段调度，或者重新算账。
events.why_it_matters_en: Responses-API compatibility makes DeepSeek a near drop-in inside OpenAI-native agent stacks. The confirmed peak/off-peak rates are a large increase over the current flat rates: V4-Pro output rises from $0.87 to $3.96/Mtok at peak and $1.98 off-peak, effective 2026-08-16T16:00Z. Budget-sensitive agent workloads now need time-of-day scheduling or a fresh cost review.
events.update_2026_08_16: Exact peak/off-peak rates confirmed from official pricing docs during 2026-08-16T00:00Z run. Net effect is a substantial price increase, not a discount: even off-peak V4-Pro output is ~2.3x the current flat rate, and peak is ~4.6x. Peak windows align with China business hours (09:00-12:00 / 14:00-18:00 Beijing). Concurrency limits unchanged: flash 2500, pro 500.

events.title: OpenAI previews Ultrafast mode: GPT-5.6 Sol on Cerebras at up to 750 tok/s
events.title_zh: OpenAI 预览 Ultrafast 模式，GPT-5.6 Sol 提速 14 倍
events.published_at_note: Timing discrepancy: TechCrunch article published 2026-08-13T19:22Z; openai.com/index/previewing-ultrafast/ page metadata shows publishedTime 2026-08-11T10:00Z. Staged announcement likely; treated as Aug 11-13 boundary event.
events.summary: OpenAI announced a preview of Ultrafast mode, serving GPT-5.6 Sol at up to 750 output tokens per second, about 14x the standard mode. Inference runs on Cerebras wafer-scale hardware instead of GPUs. Access is limited to a small preview group, and pricing is undisclosed.
events.why_it_matters: This is the first time OpenAI serves a frontier model on third-party, non-GPU inference silicon. It validates alternative inference hardware at frontier quality, and it signals that speed-tiered API products are becoming the next competitive axis.
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 预览了 Ultrafast 模式：GPT-5.6 Sol 的输出速度最高可达 750 tokens/s，约为标准模式的 14 倍。推理由 Cerebras 的晶圆级（wafer-scale）硬件承担，不再用 GPU。目前仅向少量预览用户开放，定价未公布。
events.summary_en: OpenAI announced a preview of Ultrafast mode, serving GPT-5.6 Sol at up to 750 output tokens per second, about 14x the standard mode. Inference runs on Cerebras wafer-scale hardware instead of GPUs. Access is limited to a small preview group, and pricing is undisclosed.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 这是 OpenAI 第一次把前沿模型跑在第三方非 GPU 推理芯片上。对做推理基础设施的人来说，它验证了替代芯片在前沿质量下可行，也说明按速度分层的 API 产品正在成为下一个竞争点。
events.why_it_matters_en: This is the first time OpenAI serves a frontier model on third-party, non-GPU inference silicon. It validates alternative inference hardware at frontier quality, and it signals that speed-tiered API products are becoming the next competitive axis.

events.title: GitHub Copilot weekly: Agent Plugins 1.0 GA, JetBrains adds Ollama BYOK
events.title_zh: GitHub Copilot 周更：Agent Plugins 1.0 正式 GA
events.summary: Agent Plugins 1.0 went GA: build once, run across VS Code, Copilot CLI, Copilot SDK, and the Copilot app. Kimi K3 and MAI-Code-1.1-Flash rolled out to paid plans. Copilot CLI gained a /tasks subagent view, --plan plus --mode autopilot headless combos, and /rewind. JetBrains added cross-session memory and Ollama as a BYOK provider.
events.why_it_matters: Portable plugins are Copilot's bid for an agent-ecosystem standard to compete with MCP. For plugin authors, build-once distribution across every Copilot surface is worth tracking. Ollama BYOK in JetBrains shows local models becoming normal inside enterprise IDEs.
events.summary_zh: Agent Plugins 1.0 正式 GA：插件构建一次，就能在 VS Code、Copilot CLI、Copilot SDK 和 Copilot app 里运行。Kimi K3 和 MAI-Code-1.1-Flash 已向付费套餐推出。Copilot CLI 新增 /tasks 子 agent 视图、--plan 加 --mode autopilot 的无头组合，以及 /rewind。JetBrains 版新增跨会话记忆，并支持把 Ollama 作为自带密钥（BYOK）的模型来源。
events.summary_en: Agent Plugins 1.0 went GA: build once, run across VS Code, Copilot CLI, Copilot SDK, and the Copilot app. Kimi K3 and MAI-Code-1.1-Flash rolled out to paid plans. Copilot CLI gained a /tasks subagent view, --plan plus --mode autopilot headless combos, and /rewind. JetBrains added cross-session memory and Ollama as a BYOK provider.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对写 agent 插件的人来说，一次构建、全端运行的标准如果成型，分发成本会大降，这是 Copilot 对标 MCP 的生态尝试。JetBrains 支持 Ollama BYOK 则说明本地模型进企业 IDE 正在变成常态。
events.why_it_matters_en: Portable plugins are Copilot's bid for an agent-ecosystem standard to compete with MCP. For plugin authors, build-once distribution across every Copilot surface is worth tracking. Ollama BYOK in JetBrains shows local models becoming normal inside enterprise IDEs.

events.title: Cursor Builds: pre-warmed environments boot cloud agents up to 3x faster
events.title_zh: Cursor 推出 Builds：云端 agent 启动最高提速 3 倍
events.summary: Cursor shipped Builds: environments prepared hourly in the background so cloud agents boot up to 3x faster. Broken builds never go active; the system falls back to the last good one. A new Builds tab in the dashboard shows logs and SHAs. It becomes the default for all environments on Aug 17 at no extra cost.
events.why_it_matters: Warm environments remove the biggest latency tax on cloud coding agents. Once Builds is on by default for everyone on Aug 17, it becomes the baseline that competing products get benchmarked against.
events.summary_zh: Cursor 发布 Builds：系统每小时在后台预构建环境，云端 agent 启动最高快 3 倍。构建失败的环境不会启用，自动回退到最近一个可用版本。dashboard 新增 Builds 标签页，可查看日志和 SHA。8 月 17 日起对所有环境默认开启，不额外收费。
events.summary_en: Cursor shipped Builds: environments prepared hourly in the background so cloud agents boot up to 3x faster. Broken builds never go active; the system falls back to the last good one. A new Builds tab in the dashboard shows logs and SHAs. It becomes the default for all environments on Aug 17 at no extra cost.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对用云端 coding agent 的人来说，预热环境直接砍掉了最大的一块启动延迟。8 月 17 日全员默认开启后，它就成了同类产品衡量启动速度的基线。
events.why_it_matters_en: Warm environments remove the biggest latency tax on cloud coding agents. Once Builds is on by default for everyone on Aug 17, it becomes the baseline that competing products get benchmarked against.

events.title: Verifier finds ~40% of accepted LLM-generated GPU kernels are broken
events.title_zh: 验证器发现：约 40% 已验收的 LLM 生成 GPU kernel 有缺陷
events.summary: The paper presents a verifier for AI-generated GPU kernels built on twelve adversarial property-based gates, most of them tolerance-free; it agrees with reference correctness code 98.5% of the time. The authors used it to audit 2,638 publicly accepted machine-generated kernels: 39.5% were broken beyond any tolerance argument, and 62.1% had at least one violation. Field-standard tests accepted 1,487 kernels that the verifier rejected.
events.why_it_matters: For any team shipping LLM-generated code validated only by loose tests, this is a directly actionable warning: property-based adversarial gates belong in kernel and code CI.
events.summary_zh: 论文提出一个面向 AI 生成 GPU kernel 的验证器，包含 12 个对抗性的属性检查门（property-based gates，多数为零容差），与参考正确性代码的一致率达 98.5%。作者用它审计了 2,638 个已公开通过验收的机器生成 kernel：39.5% 存在无法靠容差解释的错误，62.1% 至少有一项违规。业界标准测试放过了其中 1,487 个被该验证器拒绝的 kernel。
events.summary_en: The paper presents a verifier for AI-generated GPU kernels built on twelve adversarial property-based gates, most of them tolerance-free; it agrees with reference correctness code 98.5% of the time. The authors used it to audit 2,638 publicly accepted machine-generated kernels: 39.5% were broken beyond any tolerance argument, and 62.1% had at least one violation. Field-standard tests accepted 1,487 kernels that the verifier rejected.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对只靠宽松测试就给 LLM 生成代码放行上线的团队，这是一条可以直接照做的警告：基于属性的对抗性检查应该进 CI，成为 kernel 和代码的必测项。
events.why_it_matters_en: For any team shipping LLM-generated code validated only by loose tests, this is a directly actionable warning: property-based adversarial gates belong in kernel and code CI.

events.title: DARTree: draft trees push diffusion speculative decoding to 9.73x lossless speedup
events.title_zh: DARTree：自回归草稿树让推测扩散解码无损提速 9.73 倍
events.summary: The paper extends a pretrained autoregressive correction head from single chains to trees, training-free, for diffusion speculative decoding. Fixed-width candidate trees are scored per depth in one batch with best-first pruning. Each verification round accepts up to 12.97 tokens, up 98.6% over DFlash and 27.9% over Domino, for up to 9.73x lossless speedup across 7 benchmarks.
events.why_it_matters: If the results reproduce, this is a material acceleration technique for inference serving, directly relevant to vLLM/SGLang-class stacks. There is no code repo yet, so treat it as watch-and-verify.
events.summary_zh: 论文把预训练的自回归修正头从单链扩展到树结构，全程免训练，用于扩散推测解码（diffusion speculative decoding）。定宽候选树按深度在一个批次内打分，配合 best-first 剪枝。单轮验证最多接收 12.97 个 token，比 DFlash 高 98.6%，比 Domino 高 27.9%，在 7 个 benchmark 上最高实现 9.73 倍无损加速。
events.summary_en: The paper extends a pretrained autoregressive correction head from single chains to trees, training-free, for diffusion speculative decoding. Fixed-width candidate trees are scored per depth in one batch with best-first pruning. Each verification round accepts up to 12.97 tokens, up 98.6% over DFlash and 27.9% over Domino, for up to 9.73x lossless speedup across 7 benchmarks.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对维护 vLLM、SGLang 这类推理栈的人来说，如果结果可复现，这是一项有实质价值的加速技术。目前没有代码仓库，先观望复现情况。
events.why_it_matters_en: If the results reproduce, this is a material acceleration technique for inference serving, directly relevant to vLLM/SGLang-class stacks. There is no code repo yet, so treat it as watch-and-verify.

events.title: DCD: decoupled contrastive decoding hits 1.65-1.95x speedup, code released
events.title_zh: DCD：解耦对比解码提速 1.65–1.95 倍，代码已开源
events.summary: Decoupled Contrastive Decoding (DCD) uses EAGLE3-style expert-aligned drafting to reach 1.65-1.95x speedup over vanilla contrastive decoding. Code is available on GitHub.
events.why_it_matters: For anyone working on inference acceleration, this is a low-cost paper to verify: the method is practical and the code is released.
events.summary_zh: DCD（Decoupled Contrastive Decoding，解耦对比解码）采用 EAGLE3 风格的专家对齐草稿生成（expert-aligned drafting），相对原版对比解码提速 1.65–1.95 倍。代码已在 GitHub 开源。
events.summary_en: Decoupled Contrastive Decoding (DCD) uses EAGLE3-style expert-aligned drafting to reach 1.65-1.95x speedup over vanilla contrastive decoding. Code is available on GitHub.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对做推理加速的人来说，这是一篇验证成本低的论文：方法实用，代码开源，不用从头复现。
events.why_it_matters_en: For anyone working on inference acceleration, this is a low-cost paper to verify: the method is practical and the code is released.
